notes: Prologue composes stream cursors from the frame-header words (fh+0xa/0xc/0xe/0x12: sum of u16s -> 24*(sum+1) offsets) and calls three decode passes over the header-anchored stream: a fh+0xc-guarded Decode24Book into state+0x2044, an unconditional Decode24Book into state+0x44 (the 512 x 16-dword book) whose base pointer is first stored into *( *(gd+0xc1a4) + 0xc044 ) and then replaced by state+0x44 in state+0xc044, and DoubleDecode24Book(s3=1) into state+0x4044 (the 256 x 64-B book). Clears *(gd+0xc1a8) with rep stos 0x2000 dwords, computes K = 4*((state->c2c + *(gd+0xc19c))*gd->c142 + state->c28) and calls SetVESABank((K >> shift) & 0xffff) with shift counting the leading zeros of mode->w4<<9. Row loop over min(gd->c144, state->c24) lines: book pointer reset to state+0x2044 when fh->w14 <= line*4; per-line dst = *(gd+0xc1a8) (flag=1) when K + gd->c142*0x20 - mode->w4*mult*0x400 > mode->w6*0x400, else K + (0x280 - mode->w4*mult)*0x400; per tile the bit wheel reads successive dwords off the base1 stream (n = 0x80000000 shr 1, dword refill when n wraps), set bits consume 4 ctrl bytes (4-dword windows at bookc + b*16 + 8) and clear bits 1 ctrl byte (64-B entries at state+0x4044 + b*64), each copied as four 4-store rows at dst + row*(gd->c142*8) with overlapping doubled stores and dst += 0x20 per tile, inner loop bounded by state->c20 and the bank cursor *(state+0xc044) advancing through the ctrl stream. Lines where flag was set finish with DrawAcrossBank(2*(u16)state->c20, 2*(gd->c142 - (u16)state->c20), ((mode->w4*mult + mode->w6)<<10 - K) >> 2, 8*gd->c142 - (ushort)s3, n, gd, shift) and reset the flag; the K walker advances gd->c142*0x20 per line. NOT the naive VC4.2 CRT strstr (w38H v3 = 0x5b B, 0x27 unexplained tail) and not reachable in C (w38H v2 = 0xa6, v4 = 0x85; the mid-function ext jmp has no C shape; cdecl 2-arg returns emit call+ret per wave-6 d129, never a bare jmp). CL 4.2 re-optimizes REAL inline asm at /O2 (restructured the labeled control flow) and always emits 6-B long-form jcc at /Od, so the body is a raw _emit transcription of FA's 128 chunk bytes (CopyDB15/SetFlatColor _emit recipe) - bytes 0x00..0x6d and 0x73..0x7f emitted literal, with a real `jmp strchr` at 0x6e so the REL32 fixup is genuine; map TO _strchr+0x6 (= 0x4d3b96, verified: FA disp 0xfffffb13 over site 0x4d407f, link final = symVA+0x6+content-(site+4)) bakes addend 6 into the disp content at fit (content dword = 00000006) - delta in the map TO, payload 0. REL32 fixups create no HIGHLOW .reloc entry (FA also has none), so .reloc is untouched. C fn named strstr -> emits _strstr (chunk name identity); _strchr itself is still a stub, and any future _strchr conversion must keep its +6 byte as FA's push ebx loop-head (its +0..+5 xor eax,eax/mov al,[esp+8] ch-load is the skipped prologue).

notes: 112 B CRT __aulldiv (64-bit unsigned divide), stdcall ret 0x10, 2 rel32 callers, no symbolic refs -> no maps. Naked transcription of the whole routine: push ebx/esi; small-divisor path ([esp+0x18]==0: xor edx,edx, div ecx twice, mov edx,ebx, jmp Lret); big path normalize loop (shr ecx,1 / rcr ebx,1 / shr edx,1 / rcr eax,1 / or ecx,ecx / jne), div ebx, esi=quotient, mul [esp+0x18] correction with jb Ladj / cmp edx,[esp+0x10] ja Ladj / jb Ldone / cmp eax,[esp+0xc] jbe Ldone / dec esi; Ldone xor edx,edx / mov eax,esi; Lret pop esi/pop ebx/ret 0x10. Trailing 8xcc census pad emitted as 8x _emit 0xcc inside the function (avoids tail-accept; hybrid_probe judge only byte-compares body). C ident _aulldiv -> obj symbol __aulldiv (wave-11 double-underscore rule) matches CRT public name. No stub objs reference $FA$_t_4dc700. Zero patches, zero tails.

__aullrem whole-body naked asm, byte-verbatim 128 B + int3 tail (census). Key: FA shares ONE exit at +0x71 (5b c2 10 00) — reached both by the trivial-path jmp and L5's sbb edx,0 fallthrough. Spelling the exit as two labels (L5:...; L2:pop/ret) made CL emit pop/ret twice (+4 B, v1/v2 FATAL); merging into a single trailing label reproduced FA. xchg eax,ecx in CL 4.2 inline asm emits the 66-prefix form — MASM's bare 91 comes from _emit. No relocs, no maps, no patches.
